newsitem.title: USA: Tower Air secures $12.5 million credit line.
newsitem.headline: Tower Air secures $12.5 million credit line.

text.p: Tower Air Inc said it has secured a $12.5 million credit line from Heller Financial Inc, in the first phase of what should be a financial strengthening of the airline.

"The extension of this first line of credit is consistent with our business goals of strengthening our financial position and to move forward over the next five years in a programmed approach to measured and responsibly managed growth," chief financial officer Ramesh Punwani said.
Tower Air operates domestic and international service from New York to Los Angeles, Miami, Oakland, Paris, Sao Paulo, San Juan and Tel Aviv.
